q: 这几项被划出范围，分别让系统省掉了哪块设计？（多选）
q_en: For each item ruled out of scope, which piece of the design does it let you skip? (select all)
options: 不做音视频通话，就不用设计实时媒体流的中继/SFU 组件，Chat Server 只处理文本与附件元数据
不做商家交互，Chat/Message 实体就不用为「商业账号」单独设计消息模板或计费字段
不做注册与资料管理，User 实体就不用设计头像、简介变更的广播机制
既然通话不在范围内，实时收发消息也可以退回普通 HTTP 轮询，不必保留 WebSocket 长连接
options_en: Skipping calling means you never design a real-time media relay or SFU component; the Chat Server only handles text and attachment metadata
Skipping business interactions means Chat and Message never need a separate message template or billing field for business accounts
Skipping registration and profile management means the User entity never needs a broadcast mechanism for avatar or bio changes
Since calling is out of scope, real-time messaging can also fall back to plain HTTP polling instead of keeping a persistent WebSocket
why: 划出范围省掉的是那个功能自己的组件（SFU、商业消息模板、资料变更广播），不影响其他仍在范围内的需求；实时消息本身仍要求低延迟双向推送，跟通话是否在范围无关。
why_en: Ruling a feature out of scope only removes that feature's own component, not the messaging path, which still needs a persistent low-latency connection regardless of calling.
scenario: 面试官明确把音视频通话、商家/企业交互、注册与资料管理划到范围外，只保留群聊、收发消息、离线补投和媒体附件。

q: 补全 WhatsApp 设计的四个核心实体：
q_en: Fill in the four core entities of the WhatsApp design:
text: 核心实体：{{User}}（用户）、{{Chat}}（2-100 人的会话）、{{Message}}（消息）、{{Client}}（同一用户可能有多台设备）。
why: Client 是同一账号下的一台已登录设备，不是泛泛前端代码。把 Client 和 User 分开，后面才能做多设备投递、per-client Inbox、ack 和重连 sync。
why_en: A Client is one logged-in device under a user, so separating it from User makes per-device delivery, ACKs, Inbox rows, and reconnect sync possible.

termDefinitions.meaning: 账号或人的身份，例如手机号、用户资料、账号级设置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A User is the account or person identity, such as phone number, profile, and account-level settings.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一账号下的一台已登录设备或应用实例，例如手机、桌面端或网页端；它会有自己的连接、ack、sync 和待投递状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Client is one logged-in device or app instance under an account, such as phone, desktop, or web; it has its own connection, ACKs, sync state, and pending delivery state.

q: 为什么实体里除了 User 还要单独定义 Client？

options: 为了给每台设备单独计费
Client 只是 User 的别名，没有实际区别
为了做灰度实验分流
一个用户可能有多台设备，投递与同步要精确到设备
options_en: To bill each device separately
Client is just an alias for User with no real difference
To route users into A/B experiments
A user may own multiple devices, so delivery and sync must be tracked per device
why: User 是账号身份，Client 是这个账号下的一台已登录设备。多设备时每台设备的连接、lastSeq、ack 和 Inbox 都可能不同，所以投递与 sync 要按 client 跟踪。
why_en: User is the account, while Client is one logged-in device, so delivery, ACKs, last sequence, and Inbox state must be tracked per client in a multi-device design.

participants = u1,u2,u3] --> B[Create Chat row
chatId, type, name, createdAt, status] B --> C[Create ChatParticipant rows] C --> C1[chatId#u1] C --> C2[chatId#u2] C --> C3[chatId#u3] C --> D[Return chatId] D --> E[Later sendMessage queries

createChat(creatorId, participantIds, name=None):
  chatId = newULID()
  members = unique(participantIds + [creatorId])

  chat = {
    "PK": chatId,
    "type": "GROUP" if len(members) > 2 else "DM",
    "name": name,
    "createdBy": creatorId,
    "createdAt": now(),
    "status": "ACTIVE"
  }

  participantRows = [
    {
      "PK": chatId,
      "SK": userId,
      "role": "ADMIN" if userId == creatorId else "MEMBER",
      "joinedAt": now(),
      "lastReadSeq": 0,
      "mute": False
    }
    for userId in members
  ]

  if 1 + len(participantRows) <= 100:
    transactWrite([chat] + participantRows)  # all-or-nothing
  else:
    put(chat with status="CREATING")
    batchWrite(participantRows)              # chunked/idempotent
    update(chatId, status="ACTIVE")

  return chatId

options: Kafka 不支持多消费者订阅
Kafka 无法持久化消息
topic 无法动态创建，这也不是这里的真正瓶颈
Kafka 不是为数十亿 topic 设计的，元数据开销太大
options_en: Kafka does not support multiple consumers on one topic
Kafka cannot persist messages
Topics cannot be created dynamically, but that is not the real bottleneck either
Kafka is not built for billions of topics; the metadata overhead is too large
optionMeanings: Kafka 支持多消费者/多个 consumer group，这不是问题。
Kafka 会把消息写入磁盘并按 retention 保存，所以它可以持久化。
Topic 可以动态创建；真正问题是创建到每个用户这个粒度太重。
正确：Kafka topic/partition 是较重的日志资源，不适合给每个用户或每台设备各建一个。
why: 每用户一个 Kafka topic 太重：topic/partition、文件、controller 元数据和 offset 都按 topic 增长。Kafka 能持久化、也能低延迟，但它不擅长按 clientId+messageId 精确查 pending、ack 后删除；WhatsApp 更适合 Message+Inbox 表兜底。
why_en: A Kafka topic per user is too heavy and awkward for per-client ACK and delete, while a Message plus Inbox table can query and clear pending rows by clientId and messageId.
whenOtherWins: Kafka 仍然适合做少量 shared topics 的后台事件流，例如消息审计、异步通知任务、反垃圾处理或分析流水线；它不适合把 topic 粒度做到每个终端用户。
tradeoff: Kafka 顺序日志的高吞吐 vs Inbox 表按 client/message 精确查询和清理

scenario: 想让「谁负责哪个用户」变成确定映射：按 userId 一致性哈希把用户固定分配到 Chat Server，服务器之间直连投递。
scenario_en: You want "which server owns which user" to be a deterministic mapping: consistent-hash users by userId onto a fixed Chat Server, and deliver via direct server-to-server connections.
q: 这个方案还需要什么配套基础设施？
q_en: What supporting infrastructure does this approach still require?
options: 中心注册表（ZooKeeper/etcd）记录哈希段归属
一个全局关系型数据库存路由，写入会成为瓶颈
客户端向全网广播自己的位置
DNS 泛解析到任意服务器
options_en: A central registry such as ZooKeeper or etcd recording which hash segments each server owns
A single global relational database storing routes, which becomes a write bottleneck
Clients broadcast their own location to the whole network
Wildcard DNS resolving to any server
why: 一致性哈希直连需要强一致控制面：server 列表、hash range owner、ring version、租约和故障接管。ZooKeeper/etcd 适合这类 watch/lease；Redis 可做缓存或 Pub/Sub，但当事实源就要自补选主、CAS 和脑裂保护。
why_en: Consistent-hash direct routing needs a strongly consistent control plane for membership, range ownership, ring versions, leases, and failover, which fits ZooKeeper or etcd better than Redis.
whenOtherWins: 不想自己管理伸缩编排、能接受多一跳毫秒级延迟时，Redis Pub/Sub 更省心，也是文中评级更高的选择。
tradeoff: 服务器直连低时延 vs 自管路由编排（注册表、扩容迁移）的运维复杂度

flowchart LR ZK["ZooKeeper/etcd
ring version + hash ranges"] --> CS1["Chat Server A
owns range 0-30"] ZK --> CS2["Chat Server B
owns range 31-60"] ZK --> CS3["Chat Server C
owns range 61-99"] Client["Client userId"] --> LB["L4 Load Balancer"] LB --> Gateway["Gateway/Chat Server
compute hash(userId)"] Gateway --> CS2 CS2 --> Peer["Direct server-to-server delivery"] CS3 -. "lease expires" .-> ZK ZK --> Reassign["Publish new ring version"] Reassign --> CS1 Reassign --> CS2
codeSample:
# Control plane: server registration and hash-ring ownership
onServerStart(serverId, address):
  zk.createEphemeral(f"/chat/servers/{serverId}", address)
  ring = zk.get("/chat/hash-ring")
  ownedRanges = ring.rangesFor(serverId)
  openPeerConnections(ring.servers)

# Routing: deterministic owner lookup from a strongly consistent ring version
routeToOwner(userId, msg):
  ring = localRingCache.current()
  owner = ring.ownerOf(hash(userId))
  sendDirect(owner.address, msg)

# Scaling: coordinator publishes a new ring version
rebalance(newServers):
  newRing = computeRing(newServers)
  zk.compareAndSet("/chat/hash-ring", expectedVersion, newRing)
  # watchers notify chat servers; they drain/migrate affected users

q: 一致性哈希直连方案要付出哪些代价？（多选）
q_en: What costs does the consistent-hashing direct-connect approach pay? (select all)
options: 每台 Chat Server 都要与所有其他 Chat Server 保持连接，迫使服务器「个头大、数量少」
扩容 / 缩容要精细编排连接迁移，避免用户集体重连引发惊群
伸缩过渡期要向新旧两台服务器同时发送事件，防止丢消息
userId 从此不能再作数据库分区键
options_en: Every Chat Server must stay connected to every other Chat Server, forcing servers to be few and large
Scaling in or out requires carefully orchestrated connection draining to avoid a thundering herd
During a scaling transition, events must be sent to both the old and new owning server so nothing is lost
userId can no longer be used as a database partition key
why: 直连低延迟，但你要自管路由编排。代价是全网状连接近似 N²、扩缩容会让一批 user 换 owner 形成重连惊群，迁移窗口还要双发或桥接，避免事件打到旧 owner。
why_en: Direct routing saves a hop, but it creates near-N-squared server links, migration herds during scaling, and old/new owner races that need draining, backoff, and bridging.
tradeoff: 直连低延迟、少一跳 vs 自己维护全网连接、哈希环迁移和过渡期双发
codeSample:

owner(user123) = Server A

# Add Server B; hash ring changes:
oldOwner = Server A
newOwner = Server B

# Transition window:
route(user123) -> [oldOwner, newOwner]  # dual-send or bridge
oldOwner.drainConnections(batch_size=small)
client reconnects with jitter/backoff

# After client is stable on B:
route(user123) -> Server B only

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A full mesh means every Chat Server connects to every other Chat Server. As the number of servers N grows, connection relationships approach N squared and become harder to maintain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缩容或迁移时不再接新连接，并把已有连接分批迁走，避免用户同时重连。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Connection draining means a server stops accepting new connections and gradually moves existing connections away during scale-in or migration to avoid simultaneous reconnects.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: The old owner is the server responsible for a userId before a consistent-hash change, and the new owner is responsible after the change. They must coordinate during the migration window.

# Send path: assign one global sequence per recipient user

  seq = redis.incr(f"seq:user:{toUserId}")
  msgId = newId()
  Message.put(chatId=chatId, msgId=msgId, userSeq=seq, body=body)
  for clientId in Clients.query(toUserId):
    Inbox.put(clientId=clientId, msgId=msgId, chatId=chatId, userSeq=seq, status="PENDING")
  redis.publish(f"user:{toUserId}", { "msgId": msgId, "seq": seq })

# Existing heartbeat: add latestSeq to the ping payload
sendHeartbeat(userId, ws):
  latestSeq = getLatestSeq(userId)  # Redis GET, local cache, or replicated presence state
  ws.send({ "type": "ping", "latestSeq": latestSeq })

# Client side: detect missed pushes without waiting for the next chat message
onMessage(msg):
  if msg.seq > local.lastSeq + 1:
    syncInbox(fromSeq=local.lastSeq + 1, toSeq=msg.seq - 1)
  apply(msg)

    ack(row.msgId)

q: 两台服务器可能先后为同一用户写断连时间戳，如何防止旧值覆盖更新的值？
q_en: Two servers might write a disconnect timestamp for the same user out of order — how do you stop a stale value from overwriting a newer one?
options: 写之前抢一把全局锁
随机退避后再写
只允许固定一台服务器负责写
DynamoDB 条件写：新时间戳更大才更新
options_en: Grab a global lock before writing
Write after a random backoff delay
Let only one fixed server be responsible for writing
A DynamoDB conditional write that only updates when the new timestamp is greater
optionMeanings: 含义：写之前抢一把全局锁
含义：随机退避后再写
含义：只允许固定一台服务器负责写

why: 条件写把「比较再更新」压进存储层原子完成：晚到的旧时间戳会条件失败，不会倒退覆盖更近的断连时间。
why_en: A DynamoDB conditional write that only updates when the new timestamp is greater prevents two servers from racing and clobbering a more recent disconnect time.
codeSample:
UpdateItem LastSeen
  Key: { userId: "u_42" }
  SET lastDisconnect = :new
  ConditionExpression: :new > lastDisconnect
# fails harmlessly if another server already wrote a newer timestamp

向全部 Chat Server 广播查询再投票，开销随集群规模线性增长
轮询目标用户直到回应，请求会一直阻塞等待，没有并行的兜底路径
options_en: Read the LastSeen table directly and return it as-is, without asking whether they are actually online right now
The server reads LastSeen and asks the target over Pub/Sub in parallel, then merges the two results to display
Broadcast the query to every Chat Server and vote, with cost scaling linearly with cluster size
Poll the target user repeatedly until they respond, blocking the whole time with no parallel fallback
why: 一次查询、两路并行响应（数据库的历史值 + 实时的在线确认），由客户端合并——存储与实时各答各的强项。
why_en: The server checks the last-seen table and in parallel forwards the query to the target's channel, and the client merges the database answer with any live online reply.

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as 请求者客户端
    participant A as Chat Server A
    participant DB as LastSeen 表

    par 并行

    and
